summary: community.routeros deprecated support for EOL Ansible versions; its next major release drops Ansible 2.9, ansible-base 2.10 and ansible-core 2.11 through 2.14.
questions: Which versions will the next community.routeros major release require?

answer_card.title: community.routeros drops EOL Ansible versions
answer_card.answer_md: The next major **community.routeros** release drops **Ansible 2.9, ansible-base 2.10 and ansible-core 2.11 to 2.14**. Use a supported ansible-core (2.15 or newer at that time).
